breaking_news.headline: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
breaking_news.summary: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

breaking_news.headline: How a pizza app changed our relationship with waiting
breaking_news.summary: Status trackers are ubiquitous on online apps and ordering. We have the story the seminal Domino's Pizza Tracker that led to many copies, and we check on why many of the trackers now aren't accurate.

breaking_news.headline: Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

breaking_news.headline: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
breaking_news.summary: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

breaking_news.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
breaking_news.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

breaking_news.headline: How a national farm leader is dealing with record diesel prices
breaking_news.summary: John Boyd Jr., president of the National Black Farmers Association, says soaring diesel costs are deepening a farm crisis as farmers face sharply higher fuel costs in the middle of harvest season.

breaking_news.headline: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

breaking_news.headline: Seven Ethiopian rebel groups form new alliance
breaking_news.summary: The groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years and now say they will work together.

breaking_news.headline: Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate
breaking_news.summary: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka is being investigated over an issue with his Covid-19 vaccination certificate.

breaking_news.headline: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
breaking_news.summary: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.

breaking_news.headline: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
breaking_news.summary: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded in most areas.

breaking_news.headline: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
breaking_news.summary: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

breaking_news.headline: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
breaking_news.summary: The chancellor has come under increasing pressure after resounding state election defeats, but says the results "go far beyond my own person"

breaking_news.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
breaking_news.summary: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

breaking_news.headline: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
breaking_news.summary: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

breaking_news.headline: Will you get £13,000 a year when you stop working? Here's how to check
breaking_news.summary: How to find out how much state pension you're likely to receive - and what you can do about it now.

breaking_news.headline: US and China discuss AI safety plan ahead of Trump-Xi summit
breaking_news.summary: Top US and Chinese officials held talks in New York on Sunday ahead of a Trump-Xi summit this week.

breaking_news.headline: Tories pledge to bring back tax-free shopping for tourists
breaking_news.summary: The party says scrapping the scheme in 2021 left the UK less competitive than European destinations.

breaking_news.headline: UK should 'team up' with Canada in new Europe alliance, Canadian minister tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: It comes after European Commission President proposed "opening the door" for Canada to become an associate member of the EU.
